narr: A severe storm tracked out of northeast Wyoming and across the northern Black Hills area to the west central South Dakota plains during the evening hours. The storm produced large hail and heavy rain across the area. Flash flooding was noted in Deadwood later in the evening as two to five inches of rain fell in about three hours from several thunderstorms.
ev: Thunderstorms during the evening hours dumped two to five inches of rain in less than three hours over portions of northern Lawrence County. Runoff from the heavy rain caused minor street flooding in Deadwood and a small portion of Crook Mountain Road to be inundated with water and debris.
lsr: County road washed out near Whitewood Creek.
